primary_question: With identical initial prompts and protected tool messages, does forwarding full versus minimum sufficient feedback change model-link task inference?
primary_view: M physical encrypted metadata; supplied model-call phase windows for attribution, separate continuous task localization
primary_attacks: released k-FP 175 timing/direction features with 1000-tree RF
secondary_attacks: signed packet size/interarrival temporal sequence classifier selected using validation only
training: fit separately within each condition; also evaluate frozen serial_full attacks; all declared learners reported
testing: formal test predictions are examined only after model/feature selection is frozen; readiness and R97 data never enter the formal held-out set
multiplicity: Holm across the two mechanism contrasts, two local models and two primary attacks; remote four comparisons form a separately identified replication family; deployment contrasts descriptive with intervals
uncertainty: paired whole-session test bootstrap 2000; LR training-and-test session bootstrap with refitting 300; conditional on designed workload and chosen learner family
permutation: within-session intended-label permutations 2000 for prefix/post recognition; paired arm correctness swap sign test at session level, 10000 draws
meaningful_effect: 10 percentage points is the predeclared practically relevant mechanism contrast; a CI crossing zero is inconclusive, not equivalence; no optional stopping on accuracy

continuous.observer: whole session clock, physical connection identifiers, no private job/stream mapping or task boundaries
continuous.unit: class-instance intervals; simultaneous repeated classes remain distinct true events
continuous.selection: validation event F1 at primary IoU .5; ties select higher threshold, then shorter window
metrics: absolute onset/offset error for matched events
continuous.instance_limit: binary class activity cannot separate two overlapping same-class instances; retain the resulting missed-event penalties and report this limitation

preservation: All planned outcomes remain in denominators with explicit unknown handling. No resampling of model outcomes, no test-driven replacement of workload.
